title: pyro.param cannot be set to CPU correctly
author: jiajunhe98

comments.author: fritzo
comments.body: Hi @hejj16 can you just be sure you've called `pyro.clear_param_store()` before inference? I wonder if an old CPU value is leaking into this run.
